headline: MONSTA X's Joohoney, TWICE's Jeongyeon pair up in new tvN show
sub: The 10-year friends travel together in Na Young-seok's 'Just Friends'
caption:
MONSTA X's Joohoney and TWICE's Jeongyeon are heading out on a trip together in tvN's new variety show 'Just Friends' (그냥사람친구).

From producer Na Young-seok, the show follows three pairs of real-life friends on a friendship trip: Joohoney & Jeongyeon (10-year friends), Lee Seo-jin & Han Ji-min, and Kim Yong-gun & Park Jung-soo. A preview of the first episode is now out, and the show premieres Nov 27 at 8:35 PM KST.

📌 Source: tvN, via Korean media (iMBC, Korea Daily)
